A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the barriers that newcomers to open source projects face are mainly social, and that there is a lack of empirical studies on technical issues.
the majority of barriers faced by OSS newcomers are related to social interaction.
newcomers face barriers when contributing to OSS projects, and the majority are non-technical barriers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a need for tools to support newcomers in their first contribution to OSS projects.
the community needs to be aware of the barriers faced by new members and to provide mechanisms to support them in overcoming these barriers.
the community needs to pay more attention to newcomers’ socialization and to the quality of the documentation available.
